notes.title: Introducing Daily Challenge!
notes.content:
Greetings Bumpers,

An update is available for Bump! Superbrawl.
Introducing a new kind of event: Daily challenge.
It lets you compete against other players, but with crazy random teams. 
Come back everyday and unlock big rewards!

In addition to this event, we're fixing multiple gameplay and display errors: 

- Fixed Dragora's projectile bouncing on empty spaces when using "Ricochet" talent
- Fixed life steal behavior when two Jiangs are attacking each other
- Fixed "Slow" attack talent
- Fixed Hariq's super attack projectile being cancelled when KOed
- Fixed Dragora's "Ricochet" talent projectile being cancelled when KOed
- Fixed Kamo's super attack move distance
- Fixed Kamo's attack push behavior
- Fixed attack DMG buff when combining "Attack Boost" and "Fired up" talents
- Fixed Nook's ice block DMG preview
- Fixed Dorn DMG and push distance previews
- Fixed Strip's arm size in VIP
- Fixed buffed attacks DMG preview
- Fixed poison immune feedback on Dragora
- Fixed preview when multiple alterations at once are displayed
- Fixed heroes' stat gauges display in menus
- Fixed Dragora's "Ricochet" talent DMG preview

See you in the arena!
The Bump Team

notes.title: TIME-LIMITED MENTORSHIP EVENT
notes.content:
[h1]BUMPERS IT IS TIME TO RALLY FORCES! [/h1]

[h2]A new event is here! Mentor your friends to unlock new rewards! [/h2]
To value the Mentorship feature and show you all the rewards you can get with it we are releasing a new event with an awesome special reward at the end!

Mentorship is a generous offer that will quickly boost your progress and we want to make sure that you are aware of all the perks that come with it. You don’t just get a Minitaur Legendary Skin for free, but a whole bunch of useful rewards for each new recruit, and also when they reach specific levels (lvl 6, 10, 14, 20, 30, 40). 

In this event, the more you mentor new players, the more EVERYBODY will win rewards as they reach a common goal (and a new Arena at 10 000 recruits!). 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464857/1f99241fe53764759abb078eb8a7d545df2b8f0f.png[/img]

It lasts one week. Good luck!

notes.title: BE READY FOR MEI HEM!
notes.content:
[h1]The first Hero Event is here![/h1] 
[h2]Complete special missions and tasks and get access to an exclusive shop to Unlock Mei Hem and awesome rewards! [/h2]

[h3]Time to discover Mei Hem: the laughing sage![/h3]
With Mei you can’t rely on appearances. As a trusted and loyal mentor, no one would suspect he had a turbulent past. But even if he is wiser now, he is always ready to kick some butts with his magic stick. His enemies think they are out of reach. Huge mistake.

[url=https://x.com/BUMPsuperbrawl/status/1887533212882145355]Discover Mei Hem's Gameplay![/url]

[b]ATTACK: Flurry of Blows [/b]
Mei Hem deals 4 successive hits dealing damage to rivals 4 times.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464857/612238587c68c628c7f7326d5784c25cbdf23ec5.png[/img]

[b]SUPER ATTACK: Divine Stomp[/b]
Mei Hem leaps into the air and lands at the chosen location, dealing damage to nearby rivals. If it KOs a rival, hero can be played again on the next turn.

Don't let him get any KOs or it will be [strike]twice [/strike] four times the pain! 
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464857/6d7f9eda098cb2765a5da9e7a5e87f43928d3d0f.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464857/136b63a6ef30f38d3ce6d16678ecb9c31f85afa3.png[/img][/url]
